shots.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side. A man in a green shirt sits at the screen-side window seat proposing a holiday, while a woman in an orange shirt sits at the door-side window seat and a woman in a white shirt sits at the screen-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the glass-door end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The woman in an orange shirt suggests a river trip, but the man in a green shirt argues that a countryside cottage would be quieter.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the walkway side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in an orange shirt asks if water travel provides better scenery, and the man in a green shirt replies that a boat journey is too inconvenient.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the presentation-screen end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the glass door, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.
